# Atlas invoice tag coverage and cost export reconciliation — facts

> Source-anchored units about Atlas invoice tag coverage and cost export reconciliation: 19 across 6 sources. Each line ends in the URL and anchor it came from; `keywords:` names the lexicon terms that matched.

<!-- generated by llms-concept-abstractor v1.4.1 · generated 2026-10-31 · 19 units · 6 sources · rights: quote -->

## Structure and components

- [statement] Legacy invoice CSV credits appear as negative Amount rows whose Description contains Credit. MongoDB says filtering these rows allows calculation of the invoice subtotal; retain the credit rows separately when explaining the difference from gross usage. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-14) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/billing/invoices.md · keywords: Atlas invoice tag coverage and cost export reconciliation

## How it works

- [statement] Invoice CSV and Admin API tags reflect configuration at export or request time, including only the latest configuration after within-cycle changes. Methodology implication: preserve dated exports or ownership history when chargeback requires historical attribution. (high confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-14) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/billing/invoices.md · keywords: Atlas invoice tag coverage and cost export reconciliation · also: https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/reference/faq/billing.md
- [statement] Pelanor documents one connector per Atlas organization and unmodified CSV Usage Summary uploads. Re-uploading a month replaces that month's existing data. This replacement behavior matters when refreshing exports after tag changes or invoice closure. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-30) — https://docs.pelanor.io/integrations/services/mongodb · keywords: Atlas invoice tag coverage and cost export reconciliation
- [statement] FOCUS maps projects to SubAccountId/SubAccountName, clusters to ResourceName, and resource tags to Tags. Retain organization, project, SKU, usage period, and tag dimensions when reconciling export formats. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-14) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/billing/focus-report.md · keywords: Atlas invoice tag coverage and cost export reconciliation

## Problems, failure modes and limitations

- [statement] Methodological inference: retain dated exports and tag-change history before retagging if chargeback must reproduce historical ownership; regenerating an invoice alone cannot establish the tags present when usage occurred. (medium confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/billing/invoices.md · keywords: Atlas invoice tag coverage and cost export reconciliation · also: https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/reference/faq/billing.md

## Comparisons and alternatives

- [statement] CSV credit rows have negative Amount values. Separately, billed usage can differ from consumed usage because of subscription minimums or charges spanning months; reconciliation must identify which total it targets. (low confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/billing/invoices.md · keywords: Atlas invoice tag coverage and cost export reconciliation
- [statement] Late cloud-provider reporting can move month-end usage into the following invoice, especially transfer, private endpoint, and backup charges. Reconcile usage dates separately from invoice dates instead of assuming every invoice contains only that month's consumption. (medium confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-14) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/reference/faq/billing.md · keywords: Atlas invoice tag coverage and cost export reconciliation · also: https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/billing/invoices.md
- [statement] The mongodb/atlas-billing repository marks its custom Charts billing dashboard solution deprecated and unmaintained, while retaining code for customized billing ingestion. Treat it as implementation context rather than a supported reconciliation solution. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-30) — https://github.com/mongodb/atlas-billing · keywords: Atlas invoice tag coverage and cost export reconciliation
- [statement] The June 20, 2024 Atlas release added project-defined resource tags to invoice CSV exports and invoice API responses. This scopes the older deployment-only description: validate project-tag coverage rather than assuming the original cluster-only boundary remains complete. (medium confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/release-notes/changelog.md · keywords: Atlas invoice tag coverage and cost export reconciliation · also: https://www.mongodb.com/company/blog/product-release-announcements/deployment-tags-billing-invoices-now-generally-available

## Facts and statements

- [statement] Atlas invoice CSV exports add Tag/<key> columns containing tag values; the invoice API also exposes resource tags. These support allocation dimensions beyond project and cluster names. (high confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-14) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/billing/invoices.md · keywords: Atlas invoice tag coverage and cost export reconciliation · also: https://www.mongodb.com/company/blog/product-release-announcements/deployment-tags-billing-invoices-now-generally-available, https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/release-notes/changelog.md
- [statement] The cached Atlas documentation describes FOCUS 1.3 exports with resource Tags, project SubAccountId, and cluster ResourceName. BilledCost and EffectiveCost are billing-currency values; legacy Amount maps to PricingCurrencyEffectiveCost. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-14) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/billing/focus-report.md · keywords: Atlas invoice tag coverage and cost export reconciliation
- [statement] The FOCUS endpoint excludes commitment shortfalls, taxes, adjustments, and refunds. Full invoices include payment details and can differ between usage and billed usage. Therefore, reconcile usage exports with a separate bridge for excluded invoice charges. (high confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-14) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/billing/focus-report.md · keywords: Atlas invoice tag coverage and cost export reconciliation · also: https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/billing/invoices.md
- [statement] Pending-month FOCUS values are estimates until invoice closure; MongoDB instructs consumers to pull the data again after closure to confirm final billing values. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-14) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/billing/focus-report.md · keywords: Atlas invoice tag coverage and cost export reconciliation
- [statement] Finout advertises daily line-item Atlas billing API ingestion, mapping by resource tags, and invoice reconciliation including committed-use credits and discounts. These are connector-vendor claims, not an independently tested completeness guarantee. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-30) — https://www.finout.io/mongodb · keywords: Atlas invoice tag coverage and cost export reconciliation
- [statement] A January 15, 2025 customer request reports tags in invoice CSVs but missing from the Cost Explorer usage response. This historical report warns against assuming identical tag coverage across billing endpoints; it does not establish current API behavior. (low confidence) (verified as of 2025-01-15) — https://feedback.mongodb.com/ideas/CUSTOMER-I-8608 · keywords: Atlas invoice tag coverage and cost export reconciliation
- [statement] The announcement, updated March 11, 2025, says tag propagation typically takes 48 hours and describes untagged cluster lines and non-cluster lines as lacking tags. Treat this as dated guidance, not proof that every current invoice category is untaggable. (low confidence) (verified as of 2025-03-11) — https://www.mongodb.com/company/blog/product-release-announcements/deployment-tags-billing-invoices-now-generally-available · keywords: Atlas invoice tag coverage and cost export reconciliation
- [statement] Atlas documents FOCUS 1.3 reports in the console and API. BilledCost and EffectiveCost use billing currency; PricingCurrencyEffectiveCost maps to legacy Amount/totalPriceCents, and x_PricingCurrencyRate supplies the Atlas Credit price. Avoid treating legacy amounts as unconditionally equivalent to billing-currency cost. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-14) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/billing/focus-report.md · keywords: Atlas invoice tag coverage and cost export reconciliation
- [statement] Pending FOCUS values are estimates until invoice closure; MongoDB instructs consumers to re-pull after month-end. Reports have single-organization scope, and cross-organization billing requires a report for each listed invoiceId. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-14) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/billing/focus-report.md · keywords: Atlas invoice tag coverage and cost export reconciliation
- [statement] DoiT's November 7, 2025 integration announcement describes automatic Atlas billing and usage ingestion across organizations, projects, and SKUs, including cluster, backup, and storage breakdowns. It demonstrates an independent ingestion implementation, not independent verification of Atlas tag completeness. (low confidence) (verified as of 2025-11-07) — https://www.doit.com/changelog/mongodb-intelligence-finops-visibility-for-atlas-built-into-doit-cloud-intellige · keywords: Atlas invoice tag coverage and cost export reconciliation
